title: De mensuris et ponderibus (Cap. I tip)
author: Epiphanius of Salamis
blurb: Epiphanius of Salamis, De mensuris et ponderibus — tip densify of Cap. I from locked PG 43 Greek. New English for private study. Tip covers measures/weights, ten prophetic genres, and prophetic signs.
era_note: Written c. 392. Tip covers Cap. I opening only; remainder of De mensuris remains.
first_english_note: Prior English exists (Dean 1887 PD); this is a new rendering from locked Greek for Cap. I.

text_history.method: English densified from locked PG 43 Cap. I tip OCR; earlier scaffold English discarded.
